resources.string: AntiReel reads visible reel player labels and page changes in your selected platforms to estimate reel views and time, and show Miso. Processing stays on your device; screen text is not saved or uploaded. Password and editable fields are excluded. At your daily limit, AntiReel requests media pause, goes Home and shows a warning. It never clicks buttons, scrolls feeds or enables permissions for you. Pause in AntiReel or disable this service anytime.
